text_block_list.text:
While walking through the academy, I came 
across Ikuno Dictus and Fine Motion 
searching through the bushes for 
something.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Mmm, it's not here... My ramen...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, it doesn't seem there's any 
ramen hiding in these bushes.
choice_data_list: Ramen doesn't live in the grass, does it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, no! I just dropped my tonkotsu 
ramen keychain.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
After hearing about it, we split up to 
search, but... Trainer, does anything ring 
a bell?

With a little time to spare, I decided to 
help them search for their keychains.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
That keychain? Hmm, I was on cleaning 
duty, but I didn't see it anywhere...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. It's not here. I'm certain I had it 
between leaving the dorm and arriving at 
this classroom, though.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
“...... By the way, do you remember what 
time you came to the classroom?”

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Umm... Right after morning training ended. 
Around 8:30, I think...?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"After class ended, you had a meal here... 
and finished at 13:10, was it?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I remember eating the limited-time 
black tonkotsu ramen and comparing it with 
the keychain.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I see. So you still had it at that point. 
...Where did you head after that?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
After eating, I visited the student 
council room to deliver a letter from my 
father.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Does anyone happen to remember what 
time that was?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It was 13:25. I remember checking the time 
on the clock hanging right beneath the 
"Eclipse first, the rest nowhere" plaque.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Hm. If that keychain was around, I had 
a flash of inspiration that it'd be "on 
top of the shelf list!"... but 
unfortunately, it doesn't seem to be here.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hoh. So playing off "rest nowhere", it's 
"rest nowhere" and "it's on the top of the 
list"... Is that the idea?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Uma-i! Because it's ramen!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha!!!!

Afterward, we retraced Fine Motion's steps 
to check everywhere she'd visited before 
after-school hours... but in the end, we 
couldn't find the keychain.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Will it really never return? My 
ramen...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...No. The thread leading to the truth—or 
rather, the noodle— might still be 
connected, you know.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If I may say so, I have diligently taken 
notes on Fine-san's schedule throughout 
the entirety of today.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And so—from a management perspective, 
there is one part that 'smells' fishy.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes... the time you finished your meal, 
13:10. Time of arrival at the student 
council room, 13:25. That is a 15-minute 
gap.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It has taken quite a long time for a 
simple journey. Did something... happen 
along the way?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
“Well, um... I had a bit of time before 
our meetup, so I just stopped to chat with 
some friends on the way...”

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Well then, have a wonderful day.

text_block_list.name: Student Talking in the Distance
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, did you hear? About the upcoming 
limited cafeteria ramen... You won't 
believe this, but—”

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, back then... I heard 
rumors about a new ramen flavor and rushed 
over without thinking...!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Found it! Here it is! I must've dropped it 
in the heat of the moment!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, thank you so very much, Ikuno-chan. 
If it weren't for you, ramen would have 
vanished into the world of darkness 
forever."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, no. All I did was make a simple 
conjecture, after all.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Strictly—from the standpoint of "time 
management," of course.
choice_data_list:
Master one art and you master them all, 
huh.

Master one art and you master them all, 
you know.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Strictly—from the standpoint of "time 
management," of course.
choice_data_list:
Master one art and you master them all, 
huh.

Master one art and you master them all, 
you know.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Master Detective Ikuno-chan! How about it? 
Why don't we open a detective agency 
together in Ireland? I'll be your 
assistant!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Then... how about "Soy Sauce & 
Tonkotsu Detective Agency" or "Salt & 
Light Broth Detective Agency"?

It was a scene where Ikuno Dictus's 
"management deduction method" truly shone.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Just like the Japanese proverb says! With 
your management skills, Ikuno-chan, you 
could even make delicious ramen!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I am somewhat intrigued. To celebrate 
solving the case, shall we all make it 
together?

And so, we wrapped up the incident by 
making a light, refreshing soy sauce 
ramen, concluding the case with a 
flourish.
